intent.description: One sentence stating the shopper or system outcome. Good: "Enable shoppers to remove a whole recipe from the basket in one action". Bad: "Adds cart-line removal to the modify-cart action".

summary.description: 2-4 sentences about consequences and risks, not a changelog of layers. Good: "Shoppers can delete an entire recipe without toggling expand. Wrong line targeting would leave items in the basket." Bad: "The PR carries recipe grouping through the basket and submits cart-line commands."

start.description: Inclusive first hunk line id in this source-ordered range (insert, delete, or context).

end.description: Inclusive last hunk line id in this source-ordered range (insert, delete, or context).

explanation.description: Plain Markdown briefing: synthesis of section briefings one level up. Consequence first; 2-4 sentences or bullets. No This file/Adds/Import openers. Title-plus: add information the title cannot carry alone. Optional Reviewer attention: only when needed.

branches.description: Ordered parent-child branches defining the file's Section Tree.

title.description: Names the reviewer question, not the code verb. Good: "Skip empty removals". Bad: "Import the cart-line removal builder".

explanation.description: Plain Markdown briefing: why this cohesive chunk matters for the outcome. Consequence first; 2-4 sentences or bullets. No This file/Adds/Import openers. Title-plus: add information the title cannot carry alone. Optional Reviewer attention: only when needed.

changedLineRanges.description: Minimal source-ordered inclusive changed-line ranges owned by this section.

branches.description: Ordered parent-child branches defining file review order for this Review Stack.

explanation.description: Plain Markdown briefing: why the child belongs under the parent. Consequence first; 2-4 sentences or bullets. No This file/Adds/Import openers. Title-plus: add information the title cannot carry alone. Optional Reviewer attention: only when needed.
